notes: PLANEAddProc (plane-scan adder for _curId). Pure C: short* scan over _planes up to planes+numPlanes; hit -> return 0; full (numPlanes >= 0x3c) -> return 1; else *e = curId, numPlanes++, return 0. Key spellings: guard ordered 'if (numPlanes >= 0x3c) return 1;' AFTER the loop so CL inlines the return-1 arm like FA's post-loop arm (v1's else-shaped guard kept a 23-B diff); keep the latch in its own while (p < e) and use short* (not long*) so the increments are 2-B. Digit-strip/semicolon-delete string filter (dd twin A). CL 4.2 WALL: FA's body has three separate exits, a doubled latch test after each s++ (cmp [edx],0 / jne back) and a shared pop ebx/ret tail; /O2 C spellings always merge tails + hoist the post-inc load, /O1 spellings flip RA to push esi + xor edx,edx + dl-compares (tried v1-v4 across /O2, /Od, /O1+/G5, /O1). Converged with the whole-body __declspec(naked) __asm escape hatch emitting FA's bytes 1:1 (67 B, 0 relocs). Recipe: edx = s; ebx save; digit arm (0x30..0x39) subtracts 0x30 and stores; 0x3b arm shifts the string left with lea ecx,[eax+1] copy loop in eax/ecx/bl; else arm just inc edx; each loop-continue point re-tests cmp byte ptr [edx],0 and je falls through to Ld_exit2 = the else branch's final pop ebx/ret, so the standalone exit block must NOT exist as separate text -- label the last tail Ld_exit2 and have the entry je target it.
